invariants.rationale: The entire body is nested inside an if condition checking for this, which must hold at method exit.
The map is dereferenced with map.getTileSets(), so it must be non-null at all program points after the null check.
imageResolver is used to resolve an image (imageResolver.getImage(image.path())), so must be non-null.
tideFile is used to resolve the image file and passed to getRelativeFileHandle.
element is used to retrieve children and attributes, requiring it to be non-null.
